potential_unspecified_behavior: The test fixture's fetch stub now answers 404 for one id and holds another until window.__releaseLate() runs. Neither behaviour is declared.

FileHeaderRowPortal returns null for the whole row when trailing is set but the trailing container has not mounted yet (FileHeaderRowProvider.tsx, the end of FileHeaderRowPortal). This matches spec item 2's 'not drawn yet' for the toggle. It also holds back the row itself, which the spec does not state.
regression_risks: If Header ever renders the trailing div conditionally or later than the row container, every hosted file page with an inspector would draw no row at all, because the portal waits on both containers.
test_coverage: The e2e cases cover I1 through I10 against the new fixture arrangements. The vitest cases cover DOM order, focus order, the swap, loading to loaded, and leaving the page.
